answer: Farm keys stall at a one-body frost fence. A newcomer sinks 2.04 POA into a tundra cache that thaws only after 16 hours and a live-tip checksum. It must then loft four 15-byte plume flares, each released only after the prior flare is on-ledger and 110 minutes later, signed from four different ASNs inside a 7-minute gale window. Three auditors rebuild the checksum and drop any reused 11-byte collar. If five caches thaw from one wallet in 10 hours, or two caches share two flares, every cache stays frozen and the 2.04 POA is burned. A late flare leaves the cache sealed; it cannot be reassigned.
